verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's docs confirm a Session Replay product for watching real user sessions to see why customers drop off. They also describe UI-managed sampling, saved replay playlists and AI summaries across replays. Nothing in the evidence addresses masking of sensitive input, by default or otherwise, so only half the story is shown. Missing for 10: documentation that sensitive inputs are masked by default, masking/privacy configuration controls, and independent hands-on corroboration of replay quality.
